original_card.question: Can one reproducible environment or artifact-comparison failure be repaired?
methods: Reproduce one portability failure and add a minimal cross-environment fix.
Audit one canonical-payload comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Preserve immutable source hashes and proof-relevant content; a different compressed byte stream alone is not a mathematical mismatch.

first_step.inspect: Resolve the current selected review, separate complex/ordinary BIT/admitted BIT/outer budgets, and compare the card against live handoffs before starting. Historical ceilings require exact source/model equivalence.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; not a scientific replay or all-size proof. Materialize selected inputs if this checkout is sparse.

original_card.first_experiment: Reproduce one specific mismatch or audit one canonical comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Portable exact checks prevent environment failures from blocking valid contributions.
allowed_variations: One interpreter/version mismatch or one payload field comparison.

actual_scope: Independently audit PR6334 exact Git-path preservation on POSIX, including materialized CR/LF/CRLF names, symlinks and complete-versus-partial overlap coverage, against the retained canonical-main helper.
scope_change_reason: The portable-replay card starts from compressed artifact/environment mismatches. PR6334 explicitly requests independent POSIX coverage after Windows-only validation. This task takes that concrete handoff and audits exact path identity and coverage reporting rather than compressed-payload equivalence.
bottleneck_link: Reliable overlap inventory prevents a false complete-coverage report from hiding prior research. This is contributor-tool verification and does not improve or audit the selected multiplication construction.
stop_rule: Stop after the bounded POSIX source-bound differential fixtures and meaningful rejecting controls have an explicit result, or report the first unresolved failure. Do not expand into a mathematical replay, shared-helper rewrite or full historical suite.
evidence: The package retains both exact helper versions and the shared dependency with origin hashes in SOURCE-VERSIONS.json. verify.py supplies bounded independent POSIX fixtures and emits source-bound results. Final measured replay evidence is recorded in README.md and the package evidence files; no scientific replay is claimed.
author: Hao Yan (@FanPUYen)

open_questions.blocked_by: An identified integration commit is required; pending-head success cannot establish merge-result behavior.
